meta.name: framing-timeout
meta.description: No face is found: FRAMING reaches its 15 s cap, one lighting coaching turn follows, and 15 s later the server ends with attempts_exhausted, retry true, then close 1000. Media streams continuously: server pings every 1 s, stats every 500 ms and attest every 1000 ms of video pts, each attest chained over the summarised media with zero-filled payloads.
